concept.description: Method leaving the process (network). Label :OutboundCall; property needsTimeout=true when the client must be configured with timeouts.
Inbound asynchronous entry point. Label :MessageConsumer, property consumerKind = 'broker' | 'event'.
Multi-pod mutual exclusion protecting a method (label :DistributedLock).
Type building a client with timeouts (label :TimeoutConfigured).
Method or type guarded by retry / circuit breaker / bulkhead / time limiter (label :ResilienceGuarded).
Labels processed-message / inbox store types (parameter idempotencyTypeRegex) as :IdempotencyStore.
concept.cypher: MATCH (:Artifact)-[:CONTAINS]->(t:Type) WHERE t.fqn =~ $idempotencyTypeRegex SET t:IdempotencyStore RETURN count(DISTINCT t) AS IdempotencyStores

constraint.description: A type issuing outbound calls must configure its client with connect/read timeouts.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method)-[:INVOKES]->(o:Method:OutboundCall) WHERE NOT t:Test AND o.needsTimeout = true AND NOT t:TimeoutConfigured RETURN DISTINCT m AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, o.signature AS Detail

constraint.description: An outbound call should be reachable from a retry / circuit-breaker / bulkhead guarded method.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method)-[:INVOKES]->(o:Method:OutboundCall) WHERE NOT t:Test AND NOT m:ResilienceGuarded AND NOT t:ResilienceGuarded AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (g:Method:ResilienceGuarded)-[:INVOKES*1..3]->(m) } RETURN DISTINCT m AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, o.signature AS Detail

constraint.description: A broker message consumer must reach an idempotency store (processed-message table / inbox) so that redelivery is harmless.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method:MessageConsumer) WHERE NOT t:Test AND m.consumerKind = 'broker' AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (m)-[:INVOKES*1..3]->(:Method)<-[:DECLARES]-(:Type:IdempotencyStore) } RETURN DISTINCT m AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, m.signature AS Detail

constraint.description: A scheduled job runs on every pod: protect it with a distributed lock (ShedLock / clustered Quartz).
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method:ScheduledJob) WHERE NOT t:Test AND NOT m:DistributedLock AND NOT t:DistributedLock RETURN DISTINCT m AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, m.signature AS Detail
